SmartBillions.commitDividend(address) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#459-478) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- share = balances[_who] * 0xffffffff / totalSupply (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#468)
	- balance += share * dividends[last] (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#471)

SmartBillions.invest(address) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#399-431) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- walletBalance += (investing * 5 / 100) * 2 (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#416)

SmartBillions (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#118-772) has incorrect ERC20 function interface:ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#33)

SmartBillions.betOf(address) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#513-535) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- hash == 0x1000000 (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#527)

SmartBillions.betPrize(SmartBillions.Bet,uint24) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#482-508) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- (hit & 0xF00000) == 0 (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#485-491)

SmartBillions.betOf(address) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#513-535) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- (player.value == 0) || (player.blockNum <= 1) || (block.number < player.blockNum) || (block.number >= player.blockNum + (10 * hashesSize)) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#515-518)

SmartBillions.addHashes(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#672-689) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- require(bool)(hashFirst == 0 && _sadd > 0 && _sadd <= hashesSize) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#673)

SmartBillions.won() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#540-591) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- (player.value == 0) || (player.blockNum == 1) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#546)

SmartBillions.putHash() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#735-756) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- lastb == 0 || block.number <= lastb + 10 (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#737)

SmartBillions.won() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#540-591) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- player.blockNum == 0 (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#542)

SmartBillions.won() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#540-591) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- hash == 0x1000000 (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#566)

ERC20.allowance(address,address).owner (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#32) shadows:
	- ERC20Basic.owner (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#23) (state variable)

SmartBillions.changeAnimator(address) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#278-283) should emit an event for: 
	- animator = _who (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#282)

SmartBillions.changeOwner(address) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#267-272) should emit an event for: 
	- owner = _who (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#271)

SmartBillions.setBetMax(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#298-300) should emit an event for: 
	- hashBetMax = _maxsum (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#299)

SmartBillions.setInvestStart(uint256) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#289-292) should emit an event for: 
	- investStart = _when (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier4/contracts/ds_t4_013.sol#291)
